name: tcgplayer-seller-location
description: Chrome extension that shows each seller's city and state next to their name in the listings on TCGPlayer product pages.

scripts.check: node --check listings.js && node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'));console.log('manifest.json valid')"
